steps.details:
Paramètres de l'action :
{
  "code": "pip install playwright -q && playwright install --with-deps chromium -q && cat > script.py << 'EOF'
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
import sys

with sync_playwright() as p:
    browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
    page = browser.new_page()
    try:
        page.goto('https://vt.tiktok.com/ZSqoQUWBT/', wait_until='networkidle', timeout=60000)
        page.wait_for_selector('video', timeout=30000)
        video_url = page.eval_on_selector('video', 'el => el.src')
        if video_url:
            print('RESULT_OK:' + video_url)
        else:
            print('RESULT_FAIL: Balise video trouvée mais attribut src vide')
            sys.exit(1)
    except Exception as e:
        print('RESULT_FAIL:' + str(e))
        sys.exit(1)
    browser.close()
EOF
python3 script.py
"
}
